invariants.statement: Stable actor FQN is independent of replaceable process and execution identity.
Organizational messages carry information but never execution authority.
Every fanout recipient owns a distinct durable delivery.
Hop, progress, and root-work budgets survive role and message changes.
Recovery is bounded, duplicate-safe, and terminal for poison work.
Feature decomposition is finite and Teams-authoritative.
Human identity, response, and task linkage are exact and durable.
External cognition and transport remain non-authoritative.
